title: Drawn-Response Corpus Partition Manifest
$comment: Defined by docs/research/TASK-0011_PHASE_1_EXECUTION_SPEC.md section 8.1 (partition sizes and governance coverage) and section 6.1 (role access control). Partitioning happens by underlying response before photograph/preprocessing variants are created. Item authors may access development cases but must never access locked_holdout or challenge cases (Architecture Review section 4.11 review-sequence; spec section 6.1).

corpus_version.description: Versioned identifier for this manifest snapshot, e.g. 'phase1-v0.1'.

item_id.description: One manifest covers one item's response partitions (e.g. 'DRG-P1-01').

archetype.description: The three phase-1 archetypes from spec section 1.

partition.description: Spec section 8.1 table: development=15/item, calibration=10/item, locked_holdout=20/item, challenge=5/item.

capture_image_ids.description: Spec section 8.1: at least two captures per response.

access_locked.description: Must be true for locked_holdout and challenge partitions until the one-time comparison opens (section 6.2 step 10; section 8.1).

authorized_roles.description: Roles from spec section 6.1 permitted to access this response's labels before the partition unlocks.

excluded_principals.description: Named individuals barred from this response, e.g. the item's own author for locked_holdout/challenge entries, or one of a blind pair's two validators barred from seeing the other's labels (section 6.1: 'same person may not label both sides of a blind pair').

characteristic_tags.description: Used to check the section 8.1 governance coverage minimums (>=15% partial_credit, >=10% contradictory_or_inconsistent, >=10% ambiguous_or_adversarial across the eligible corpus). Not mutually exclusive.
